note:
Paper-split registry (Muse + Claude, Oct 25-26, 2026). PAPER RECORD ONLY: reads alerts.json, liquidity/alerts.json and
liquidity/gaps.json, writes splits.json + SPLITS.md. Units only (1u flat after fees, as in the feeds) - no dollar amounts.

Registry discipline (every split): written definition, start date, promotion bar, KILL bar.
  - Kill bar (all splits): 30+ resulted at <= -0.10u/play -> CLOSED (sticky: stays closed once hit).
  - Promotion bar: scan-derived splits >= 30 forward resulted AND >= +0.10u/play;
    a-priori splits (defined before looking at the data) >= 20 resulted AND positive.
  - Meeting a promotion bar only makes a split ELIGIBLE: promotions happen at scheduled reviews, never mid-stream.
Forward only: a split counts plays alerted on/after its start date.

Oct 27 (Peter + Muse): liquidity spreads CLOSED by decision (status only: prints still log and grade as before); three
time-block watch splits (liq_overnight, liq_evening, ntfy_evening). All clock times are America/New_York via zoneinfo
(DST-aware). Lead = start_utc minus alert_utc everywhere here; minutes_before_start is not used.
Streams: SENT (pushed), MUTED (logged, never pushed), LIVE (phase-1 subset of SENT), LIQ-MAIN, LIQ-EXTRA.
"Paper" = never bet. ALL PLAYS = every resulted play in a stream; GRADED ERA = Oct 20+ only.

splits.name: Phase-1 live filter (paper view)
splits.definition: Sent alerts priced on ProphetX at alert time, Grade A/B, NCAAF/NBA spreads or unders, NFL unders only, not sent 12-24h before start, not late. Muse AGREE is applied in the executor ledger, not here.

splits.name: Phase-1 control group
splits.definition: Sent ProphetX-priced Grade A/B alerts that phase 1 EXCLUDES (overs, moneylines, NHL, NFL, MLB, or 12-24h before start). Shows whether the cuts help forward. No promotion bar; kill bar not applied.

splits.name: Hard Rock-priced, routed
splits.definition: Sent alerts priced on Hard Rock, graded at the alert price (the executor routes them to the best exchange).

splits.name: Fade Hard Rock-priced
splits.definition: Same alerts as 'Hard Rock-priced, routed' (sent, priced on Hard Rock), graded on the OTHER side at the real opposite-side price logged when the alert fired (fade_units, 1u after fees). Plays without a logged fade price do not count. Read next to HR-routed: both directions of every Hard Rock-priced alert.

splits.name: PM-global-priced, routed
splits.definition: Sent alerts priced on global Polymarket, graded at the alert price (routed to the best exchange). Closing population: global PM left RETAIL_BOOKS on Oct 25.

splits.name: Unders only
splits.definition: Sent alerts on unders (any book, any sport).

splits.name: Combined filter
splits.definition: Sent alerts NOT priced on Hard Rock, NOT sent 12-24h before start, NOT overs.

splits.name: Priced -125 or worse
splits.definition: Sent alerts with price after fee at -125 or worse.

splits.name: College basketball
splits.definition: Every NCAAB alert, sent or log-only (the AP Top 25 rule mutes the rest). November Pinnacle numbers are softer (preseason ratings): early reads carry a signal-quality discount.

splits.name: Fade alerts sent 12-24h out
splits.definition: Sent alerts 12-24h before start, graded on the OTHER side at the real opposite-side price logged when the alert fired (fade_units). Plays without a logged opposite price do not count.

splits.name: Tier 2 core (paper)
splits.definition: Paper record only, no money and no size. SENT alerts passing the phase-1 filter (ProphetX-priced, NCAAF/NBA spreads + unders, NFL unders, not 12-24h, not late), after-fee price -130 or better, monitor grade B, and market = NCAAF/NBA spread or NBA under. Feed-side core of Muse's Tier 2 (Muse adds Muse grade 80+, depth at the alert number and a second-signal overlap). Forward from Oct 27.
splits.promotion_bar: sizing discussion opens only at >= 30 forward resulted AND >= 70% wins AND >= +0.30u/play, at a scheduled review; below that, record only
splits.kill_bar: label dies at <= 55% wins on 20+ forward W/L (sticky)

splits.name: Evening sends, ex-Hard Rock
splits.definition: SENT alerts whose pricing book is not Hard Rock, sent 8:00 PM-11:59 PM ET (alert_utc, DST-aware). Watch split, not a cut: overlaps the 12-24h lead band heavily. Historical read (Muse, ex-HR): -0.22/play, n=20.

splits.name: Muted midday (11 AM-2 PM ET)
splits.definition: MUTED alerts only (sent_to_phone false), alerted 11:00 AM-1:59 PM ET (alert_utc, DST-aware), all books, all markets. Forward watch, NOT an unmute: if it holds >= +0.10/play at 30 forward resulted, unmuting midday non-Top 25 alerts becomes a review question for Peter. Historical read (Muse, ALL PLAYS): 24-8, +12.60u, +0.39/play, n=32, concentrated (ProphetX-priced 16-1, +12.67u; +10.90u from the week of Oct 12); graded era +1.70u on 13.

splits.name: Liquidity totals, no sharp agree
splits.definition: Liquidity main feed, market = total, sharp_agree empty, artifacts excluded, alerted from Oct 22 10:30 AM ET.

splits.name: Liquidity vs sharp (oppose)

prophetx_tripwire.rule: next 30 forward ProphetX-priced plays at or below 0.00u/play = PAUSE LIVE and review early

resulted_rule: resulted = result W, L or P with a unit value (pushes count as 0u); liquidity artifacts excluded; pending and ungraded plays do not count
